title: Canonical integral-heart scalar realization and finite free local-model predicate
statement: For a prime ell and a finite extension E of Q_ell, use its canonical small presentation and its lifted valuation ring R. Form constant R-module sheaves on the profinite site, extend scalars along constant continuous functions into the condensed integer ring, and use the section-action equivalence followed by inverse image from the point. This defines the actual functor integralHeartRealization on scalar modules. The finite free local-model predicate asks for one finite constructible locally closed stratification and pro-etale covers with bounded finite free scalar complexes representing K, and the cohomology comparisons on exactly those charts. These are the existing constructions, signatures and bodies, relocated unchanged from the parent module.
